independent_critic.scope: Whole Phase4 candidate lifecycle technical and visual acceptance

mandatory_gates.candidate_creation_all_three_modes: PASS: complete exact packets archive as unapproved; repeated capture is idempotent.
mandatory_gates.explicit_decision_and_exact_promotion: PASS: reviewer, mandatory checks, confirmation, exact ticket and journal revision required; validation alone cannot promote.
mandatory_gates.stale_confirmation_and_concurrency: PASS: stale same-candidate decision and old-version ticket rejected; shared-lock revision CAS permits one concurrent writer.
mandatory_gates.atomic_storage_and_integrity: PASS: failed journal write preserves prior decision and removes uncommitted PDF; interrupted AtomicFile recovery, bounded canonical schema/hash chain, nesting, missing/tampered/oversize data and capacity tested.
mandatory_gates.invalidation_and_audit: PASS: final targeted raw pass exercises label mutation, extended-journal discard, authority revocation and expiry in letter and telephone modes; exact INVALIDATED manifest hash, cleared promoted pointer and idempotent subsequent read asserted.
mandatory_gates.process_restart: PASS: actual PID4517 to4558; exact runtime/source/lifecycle bytes retained across three modes; durable approval survives while use and new decisions remain suspended.
mandatory_gates.production_integration_and_export_isolat: PASS: build wrapper and workspace lifecycle route integrated; legacy local review and export authority remain separate; two affected prior route/confirmation identities pass.
mandatory_gates.visual: PASS: all24 native images individually viewed, six states across phone/wide light/dark, preserved byte-for-byte in final artifact.
mandatory_gates.preservation: PASS:147 prior files exact;3 intended integration files modified;4 additions;154 final manifest hashes independently verified.140 prior identities preserved,19 new gives159 distinct;2 old reruns not double-counted.
mandatory_gates.provenance: PASS: final archive SHA and all entries verified; five original raw logs exact retained; targeted retry code0 and terminal success;146 nonsigning APK payload entries identical between runs; Actual AAB bytes extracted from both source archives hash identically to their recorded digest (c1f946c203a60a1cbc79a1e9678b04806a58f5555e279dbf246822675e5ba50f).
mandatory_gates.user_owned_real_cards: PASS: six real assignments and bundled authority unchanged; runtime fixtures synthetic only.

limitations: Parent durable evidence/checkpoint save and remote readback remains a closeout gate outside this technical/visual review.
Phase4 local reference is not field-export release; Phase5 and later remain outside scope.
Synthetic fixtures certify lifecycle behavior, not geography or six real card commissioning.
APK signatures are ephemeral emulator/debug signatures, not production signing.

durable_source.purpose: Complete rebuildable source/assets/config, excluding disposable build outputs and caches
